objective: Investigate stability defects and define concise independent fixes; no implementation.

specs.title: Preserve valid Codex TOML and user configuration
specs.acceptance: Parser-valid multi-MCP/env/escaping fixtures; unowned prefix/suffix bytes preserved; ambiguous markers abort without mutation.

specs.title: Generate discoverable Codex agents
specs.acceptance: Both writers emit required developer_instructions; actual host discovers installed agent and loads its canonical persona; upgrades preserve user customization.

specs.title: Enforce MCP grants on the actual host surface
specs.acceptance: Generated-agent allowed/denied/inherited capability matrix matches reported enforcement; sync/uninstall reconcile exposure.

specs.title: Honor model selection and report what actually ran
specs.acceptance: Host defaults/pins/calibration/inheritance/preserved overrides/unavailable models tested; desired, written and observed settings distinct; selected worker model reaches dispatch.

specs.title: Diagnose and verify MCP startup
specs.acceptance: Validate config/mount/executable and bounded MCP handshake; distinguish failure stages; real isolated server starts and cleans up.

specs.title: Apply installation to the requested project only
specs.acceptance: CWD A installation into B changes only B, for OCI and binary drivers; spaces and relocation tested.

specs.title: Make MCP sync repair drift and report truthfully
specs.acceptance: Missing/drifted owned artifacts reconcile at same version; accurate counters/errors; second run byte-stable; plain versus combined sync explicit.

specs.title: Respect declared MCP version constraints
specs.acceptance: Exact/caret/tilde/zero-major/prerelease constraints stay compatible; unsatisfied constraints preserve installed state.

specs.title: Install every referenced routing resource
specs.acceptance: Recursive local references resolve in an empty consumer without source checkout; missing resources fail validation; repeat sync stable.

specs.title: Bound MCP lifecycle and container cost
specs.acceptance: Four attributable clients remain isolated; broker mode has one backing instance per isolation/config identity; disconnect/crash cleanup tested; no direct shared stdio.

specs.title: Make Junction selection deterministic
specs.acceptance: Qualifying non-named prompt chooses configured transport; nonqualifying/unavailable cases give bounded explicit fallback.

specs.title: Activate ATOMOS only for its defined context work
specs.acceptance: Relevant compose/verify lifecycle transition invokes and validates output; ordinary prompts skip; kernel fallback avoids retry/startup loops.

specs.title: Make AGENTS.md the shared instruction authority
specs.acceptance: Compatible vendors follow relative links; preserve preexisting guidance; verify relocation and declared no-symlink fallback; structured host formats remain valid.

specs.title: Complete canonical hook attachment and verification
specs.acceptance: Canonical executables attach via supported links/registrations and fire once; broken/missing/duplicate registration detected per host; preserve user hooks.

specs.title: Budget the context actually loaded
specs.acceptance: Measure actual host injection including adapters/tools/handoffs, budget representative task without losing pins, compare quality/cost and mark missing telemetry unknown.

isolated_reproductions: subsequent rewrite deletes trailing user profile
Codex model pin skipped by incompatible default profile

gaps: MCP tools unavailable in audit session
Docker client ownership and live server handshake unverified
Billed model and full host context injection unobserved
